ENVSC 200.name: Introduction to Environmental Science
ENVSC 200.description: Team-taught introductory course covering research methods, population growth, climate science, water resources, energy, and pollution, including writing exercises and presentation skills.

ENVSC 400W.name: Case Studies in Environmental Analysis and Problem-Solving
ENVSC 400W.description: Writing-intensive capstone course reviewing the field, laboratory, policy, and management aspects of environmental problem-solving through investigative methods and projects.

ENVSC 404.name: Environmental Applications of Biogeochemistry
ENVSC 404.description: Applies geochemical and biogeochemical principles to environmental analysis, remediation, and sustainable technologies, including stable isotope chemistry.

ENVSC 494.name: Research in Environmental Science
ENVSC 494.description: Allows undergraduates to design, complete, and present a research project in environmental science.

ENVSC 495.name: Internship in Environmental Science
ENVSC 495.description: Off-campus internship experience with environmental organizations, government agencies, or businesses.

ENVSC 496.name: Independent Studies in Environmental Science
ENVSC 496.description: Individual creative projects or specialized coursework in environmental science outside the scope of formal courses.
